title: COMPLETENESS_AUDIT_V7_SHIPPED
universal_lens: The completeness audit formalizes a closed-loop epistemic stack where raw empirical data is deterministically mapped to native schema columns, rigorously calibrated via conformal inference, and optimized through correlated Kelly fractions. This unifies situational state-transition dynamics with rigorous probabilistic verification, ensuring zero-dependency self-contained mathematical environments.
gsi_mapping: GSI leverages the deep-metrics EPA tables and quarter-fatigue curves as priors for Bayesian hierarchical models. Conformal intervals guarantee finite-sample coverage on recalibrated probabilities, while simultaneous Kelly optimization under correlation matrices mathematically enforces portfolio-level risk constraints across multi-dimensional sports betting markets.
gse_mapping: GSE utilizes the hardened database schema (native weekday/gametime/stadium columns) to drive Markovian state transitions. Situational reasoning operators—such as post-bye away penalties and SNF boosts—are integrated into the ensemble margin consensus, dynamically adjusting team strength ratings based on real-time contextual fatigue and motivation spots.

primitives.name: Simultaneous Correlated Kelly Allocator
primitives.verbatim_quote: No one-command data acquisition → data/download_deep.py rebuilds the entire corpus keyless (pbp ×2 seasons, NGS, combine, contracts, injuries, snap counts, PFR, nfldata core, 11 EPL seasons) — your agent never hand-fetches a file.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: bets: vector of expected value opportunities; rho_matrix: NxN correlation matrix of bet outcomes; f*: optimal fractional allocation.
primitives.assumptions: Accurate estimation of the cross-correlation matrix between distinct betting markets; frictionless trading limits.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if the correlation matrix is ill-conditioned or if extreme tail dependencies are unmodeled.

layer2.mapping: Directly implements the GSI capital allocation layer, translating calibrated edge estimates into robust, covariance-aware bankroll management strategies.
layer2.telemetry: Deflated Sharpe ratio and realized drawdown metrics.

reasoning_traces.think:
The v7 delivery represents a complete closure of the quantitative research loop, transitioning from fragmented chat history artifacts to a load-bearing, single-file sovereign primitive stack. The derivation begins with raw empirical ingestion (`download_deep.py`), establishing a deterministic mapping from heterogeneous sports data (PBP, NGS, EPL) into a unified, keyless corpus. This eliminates I/O stochasticity, ensuring the foundational dataset is reproducible.

From this corpus, the `ratings2` and `engine_math` modules extract latent team strengths using classical algebraic methods (Colley, Massey, SRS) augmented by modern Bayesian shrinkage (Elo, Glicko2). Crucially, the integration of native schema columns for situational contexts (SNF, post-bye, divisional matchups) allows these base ratings to be dynamically modulated by environmental state transitions. The resulting raw margins are then subjected to rigorous probabilistic scrutiny via `calibration2`. By employing Platt scaling, isotonic regression, and conformal inference, the system guarantees that predicted probabilities possess finite-sample coverage properties, neutralizing overconfidence biases inherent in standard logistic outputs.

Finally, these calibrated edges feed into `kelly2`, which solves the simultaneous Kelly fraction optimization problem under a specified correlation matrix. This ensures that the final betting portfolio maximizes logarithmic utility while respecting the complex covariance structure of overlapping sports markets. The self-check mechanisms embedded in every module act as invariant assertions, physically preventing the recurrence of previous failure modes like the SNF dummy silence.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This stack inherits from the foundational works of Bradley-Terry in pairwise comparison, evolving through Elo’s dynamic rating systems and Colley’s algebraic fairness. The calibration layer draws heavily from Vovk’s algorithmic probability and conformal prediction theory, bridging frequentist guarantees with Bayesian updating. The portfolio layer extends Kelly’s 1956 logarithmic growth criterion into high-dimensional, correlated spaces pioneered by Thorp and later quant finance literature.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models opposing agents—sportsbooks and market participants—as adaptive entities whose closing lines reflect aggregated, albeit noisy, information. By inverting market strength and analyzing favorite-longshot biases, the primitives treat the closing spread not as ground truth, but as a rational expectation subject to structural inefficiencies (e.g., motivation spots, fatigue curves). The agent anticipates these behavioral deviations to extract positive expected value.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict anti-collinearity veto is enforced during the transition from situational OLS regressions to the final ensemble margin. If a contextual feature (e.g., 'road streak') exhibits high variance inflation factors or overlaps significantly with base team strength ratings, it is pruned to prevent double-counting. Furthermore, the conformal calibration layer acts as a hard veto on any probability distribution failing the empirical coverage check, ensuring no miscalibrated edge ever reaches the Kelly allocator.
